o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (keltürmek), [script needed] (geltürmek). Equivalent to gəl- + -dir. Cognate with Turkish and Turkmen getirmek.
Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل خدمت (ahl-i xidmat).
From məğlubiyyətçi (“defeatist”) + -lik. Calque of Russian пораженчество (poraženčestvo).
From mərkəzdən (“ablative of mərkəz (“center”)”) + qaç- (“to run”) + -ma.
From Proto-Turkic *kïbak, *kabak. Cognate with Turkish kavak (“poplar”) and Chuvash хӑва (hăva, “willow”).
Probably ultimately from Proto-Turkic *kab-, in which case a doublet of kəpək and a cognate of Chuvash хывӑх (hyvăh, “bran”).
